blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: push — Add an item onto a stack.
pop — Remove the top stack item.
dequeue — Remove the front queue item.

blocks.title: Push
blocks.text: Adding an item puts it on top of a stack.

blocks.title: Pop
blocks.text: Removing an item takes the most recently pushed item: 7.

blocks.title: Contrast with a queue
blocks.text: A queue removes the oldest item instead (FIFO); it is suited to arrival-order processing.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict
blocks.text: The newest value 5 is on top, so Pop removes 5.

blocks.title: Worked example · Confirm and explain
blocks.text: The stack remains [3,8] from bottom to top.

blocks.title: Predict
blocks.text: After A,B,C: front=0, rear=0, count=3. The queue is full even though front==rear. rear means next free slot here, unlike Lesson 020.

blocks.title: Confirm and explain
blocks.text: Remove A: front=1, count=2. Insert D at slot0: rear=1, count=3. Physical D,B,C differs from logical B,C,D; modulo reuses the freed slot.
